race.description: Lowe Farms Farmgate Fodder Shop Pace
race.comment: MEZZANOTTI (5) is looking to improve on her last-start fourth behind Hilltop Star at Listed level over 2230m at Globe Derby Park nine days ago. Ideally placed to return to form. JILLIBY ECLIPSE (1) was out of the money two runs ago then broke and finished seventh last start over 1800m at Globe Derby Park, coming home 35 metres from the winner. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Won't find this any harder and she can bounce back. CAPTAIN CAROLINE (6) was 4.5 metres away in second at Globe Derby Park over 1800m last start at her first run back from a spell. Her last-start form is good enough to put her right in the finish. CLARENDEN REGALIA (3) ended last prep with a eighth at Globe Derby Park over 1800m five-and-a-half months ago. Can open this campaign with a more positive effort.
